title: VirSME Sales | Full CRM and Customer Operations
description: Manage leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipeline and customer workflows in one connected CRM environment.
hero: Run the customer lifecycle as one connected operating process.
intro: VirSME Sales is designed as a full CRM environment that manages the customer relationship from lead and opportunity through onboarding, delivery and the next business action.

blocks.text: CRM depth without an isolated customer silo
Manage leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipeline, activities and customer context while keeping the record connected to the operational work that follows.
Turn won deals into operating workflows
When an opportunity is won, the relevant scope, commitments, customer context and next actions can move into onboarding and delivery instead of being rebuilt manually by another team.
AI that follows the sales operating model
VirSME AI can use authorised sales SOPs, qualification rules, approval policies and handoff requirements to help coordinate what happens next.

items: Customer context that stays useful after the deal closes
